title: C&I retail tariff pricing (KBG FY2026 renewal book)
evaluator_version: tariff_pricing/v4: on holdout3 per-segment churn rules judged with a paired-SE sampling margin (z 1.645, n_min 30, pooled sd below n_min); train rules and score as v3; pre-registered
honesty_note: AlphaEvolve-compatible run, local controller; production run pending GE app provisioning; switching is one flag (--backend alphaevolve).
pricing_note: Cost is estimated from token counts x assumed USD/1M-token prices (balanced 0.50/3.00, reasoning 2.00/12.00 unless overridden by PRICE_* env vars); not a billing figure.

def price_book(customer, market):
    """Seed: cost-plus. Fixed margin on expected cost; market link only for data centers."""
    margin = 1.5
    energy = energy_cost_jpy_kwh(customer, market)
    other = non_energy_cost_jpy_kwh(customer, market)
    alpha = 0.5 if customer["segment"] == "data_center" else 0.0
    return {
        "energy_rate_jpy_kwh": round(energy + other + margin, 3),
        "alpha": alpha,
        "market_adder_jpy_kwh": round(other + margin, 3),
        "demand_charge_jpy_kw_month": round(wheeling_basic_jpy_kw_month(customer, market) + 50.0, 1),
        "deviation_band_pct": 10.0,
        "deviation_penalty_jpy_kwh": 1.0,
        "dr_discount_jpy_kw_month": 0.0,
        "term_years": 1,
    }
